_comment: Player skills (DESIGN.md §12.3), read by Skills (checked when the items load: Skills.problems()). max_level: the top skill level. points: a skill needs base x (1 + growth x level) points from a level to the next (100 for level 0 to 1, 590 for 49 to 50; 17,250 from 0 to 50). fatigue: within one raid, the first fresh points a skill earns count in full; past that each new point counts fresh / (points earned so far this raid), never less than floor (half at 500, a quarter at 1,000, a tenth from 2,500), so a raid spent doing one thing over and over can't farm a skill. Out of a raid (the Gym, crafting, eating in the hideout) there is no fatigue. skills: id, name, trains (what the CHARACTER screen says trains it), actions (points per action: a number, or a list by rarity), rules (numbers the training reads), bonuses (per_level, max: the bonus at a level is per_level x level up to max; unit share or kg; text, with %s for the value). weapon_classes: one skill per weapon class (its id is the weapon's skill in data/weapons), all with the same actions and bonuses.

skills.name: Strength
skills.trains: Moving with a load of 10 kg or more (twice as fast over 25 kg), melee hits, throws, the Gym

carry.text: %s more before the weight slows you

recoil.text: %s less recoil (with the weapon skill, up to 15%%)
